about: MNKY KONNEKT is a small web studio registered in Spain and run by Miguel López. We work with local businesses in Singapore, from hair salons and dental clinics to workshops, florists and tuition centres, that need a good website more than a big one.
You deal with one person from the first email to launch. We write the first draft before you have paid anything, so you decide with the page in front of you, not with a proposal.

highlights.label: Spanish company; the price is the price

why.title: You see the draft first

why.title: We finish it with your material

why.title: It goes live on your domain

faq.a: By card through Stripe, or by bank transfer. You receive a receipt immediately and an invoice from MNKY KONNEKT SL. No GST applies: we are a Spanish company with no GST registration in Singapore, so the price you see is the price you pay.
Yes. The domain is registered in your name and the page files are yours. If you stop the care plan, we hand everything over.

faq.q: What if I need more than one page?
faq.a: Most small businesses need exactly one good page. If you need more, a menu, a price list or a gallery, we quote it as a small add-on.

faq.q: How did you get my details?
faq.a: If we wrote to you, it was from your own website or a public listing. A draft uses only public information about your business and stock photos; nothing is copied from your site. Reply "remove" and the draft disappears the same day.
In Spain, working with Singapore on Singapore hours where it matters. Everything happens by email, with a call if you prefer one.
